presentation.title: Start with the documentation you already maintain
presentation.body: Kronika does not generate starter prose. It adopts existing Markdown from README.md and docs/, or the exact --docs paths you name, into the repository's kronika.sync.json project manifest. The documents are left byte-for-byte unchanged.

presentation.title: Initialize this repository's documentation workspace
presentation.body: Run init in a repository you maintain. Kronika validates every selected document and evidence path before one atomic manifest write. An identical manifest is unchanged, a different manifest is preserved as a conflict unless --replace is explicit, and no Brama request, document generation, command execution, or documentation rewrite occurs.
presentation.result: JSON naming every imported or unchanged document, with conflicts and rejected input reported separately
